$comment: Generated by scripts/paralayer.ts, do not edit

tools.name: account_info
tools.description: List connected browser instances, the account each is logged into, other available accounts, and the default target. Pass an instance id as `instance`; switch with account_switch.

tools.name: account_switch
tools.description: Switch the browser profile to another logged-in account (see account_info). Later calls act as it; reloads open Instagram tabs. Switching to the active account is a no-op.

params.name: username
params.description: Target account username. This or userId required.

params.name: userId
params.description: Target account id from account_info. This or username required.

tools.name: antibot_export
tools.description: Export the full antibot follower analysis (risk + type per follower) to a CSV file; returns the path.

tools.name: antibot_report
tools.description: Follower quality analysis from the last antibot scan: totals by risk and type, plus the flagged (unreviewed high/medium-risk) followers. Empty until a scan has run.

tools.name: antibot_scan
tools.description: Start a follower scan scoring each follower bot/suspicious/fresh/clean. Runs in the background; poll antibot_report. Detection only — removes no one.

tools.name: comment_add
tools.description: Post a comment on a post.

params.name: post
params.description: Post: media id, shortcode, or URL.

params.name: text
params.description: Comment text.

tools.name: comment_delete
tools.description: Delete a comment — your own, or any on your own post. Permanent.

params.name: post
params.description: The comment's post: media id, shortcode, or URL.

params.name: commentId
params.description: Comment to delete (from comments_list).

tools.name: comment_like
tools.description: Like a comment, or unlike with `unlike: true`.

params.name: commentId
params.description: Comment to like (from comments_list).

params.name: unlike
params.description: True to remove a like; default false.

tools.name: comment_reply
tools.description: Reply to a comment.

params.name: post
params.description: The comment's post: media id, shortcode, or URL.

params.name: commentId
params.description: Comment being replied to (from comments_list).

params.name: text
params.description: Reply text. Lead with @handle to notify the parent author.

tools.name: comments_list
tools.description: List comments on a post and their replies.

params.name: post
params.description: Post: media id, shortcode, or URL.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Resume token from a previous call's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

params.name: replies
params.description: A comment id: fetch that comment's replies instead of the post's top-level comments.

tools.name: dm_accept
tools.description: Accept a pending DM message request, moving it into the inbox.

params.name: thread_id
params.description: Request id from dm_requests.

tools.name: dm_list
tools.description: List recent DM conversations, the last message, and whether a reply is awaited. Read-only.

tools.name: dm_mark_seen
tools.description: Mark a DM conversation as read (up to its latest message), clearing its unread flag.

params.name: thread_id
params.description: Conversation id from dm_list.

tools.name: dm_read
tools.description: Read a DM conversation's recent messages, oldest first. Read-only.

params.name: thread_id
params.description: Conversation id from dm_list.

tools.name: dm_remove
tools.description: Decline and remove a pending DM message request (from dm_requests). Does not touch inbox chats.

params.name: thread_id
params.description: Request id from dm_requests.

tools.name: dm_requests
tools.description: List pending DM message requests (cold inbound from non-connections, which do not appear in dm_list until accepted). Read-only.

tools.name: dm_send
tools.description: Send a text message to an existing DM conversation, by thread_id (from dm_list) or username. Will not start a new conversation with someone you have never messaged.

params.name: thread_id
params.description: Conversation id from dm_list. Provide this or `username`.

params.name: username
params.description: Recipient handle of an existing conversation. Provide this or `thread_id`.

params.name: text
params.description: Message text.

tools.name: downloads_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a download started with downloads_start: stops it and deletes its saved data.

params.name: jobId
params.description: Job id from downloads_start.

tools.name: downloads_start
tools.description: Download media to this machine: a whole account's posts/reels/stories/highlights via `username`, or one post via `url` — give exactly one. Returns a job id immediately; runs in the background, poll downloads_status. Files land in a timestamped INSSIST/@username/ folder with json+csv manifests.

params.name: username
params.description: Account to download in full. Private only if followed. Omit when downloading a single post.

params.name: url
params.description: Permalink of one post to download (/p/, /reel/ or /tv/). Mutually exclusive with username; `media` and `limit` do not apply.

params.name: media
params.description: Any of: posts, stories, highlights, reels (default all). "posts" = photos, videos, carousels and every reel shared to the grid. "reels" = reels missing from the grid: cover image and counts only, no video. Only for a username download.

params.name: limit
params.description: Cap per media type. Omit for everything. Only for a username download.

tools.name: downloads_status
tools.description: Progress of a downloads_start job: items saved per type and whether it finished, paused or failed. Once on disk, reports the folder and json-manifest path (each file with likes, comments, caption). Omit jobId to list all downloads.

params.name: jobId
params.description: Job id from downloads_start. Omit to list all.

tools.name: draft_create
tools.description: Create a draft post in INSSIST Post Assistant from photos/videos. Not published/scheduled — follow with draft_schedule or draft_publish using the returned draftId. Opens an Instagram tab if needed.

params.name: assets
params.description: Photos/videos in carousel order. Absolute local path or http(s) url. jpg/png/webp/mp4/mov/webm. Up to 20.

params.name: caption
params.description: Caption, incl. hashtags and @mentions.

params.name: type
params.description: Publish as: post (default), reel or story.

params.name: musicTrackId
params.description: Track id from music_search. Needs a one-time audio permission in INSSIST.

params.name: musicTrackName
params.description: Track title from music_search, shown as label. Optional.

params.name: location
params.description: Place name to tag; first Instagram match wins.

params.name: mentions
params.description: Usernames to tag, without @. Up to 20.

params.name: stretchToFill
params.description: Fill the frame instead of letterboxing (default true). Crops a non-9:16 photo to fill a story; a no-op for a regular post unless the image is outside Instagram's allowed ratios.

tools.name: draft_delete
tools.description: Remove a post from INSSIST Post Assistant, with its media. Only touches the INSSIST queue: a published entry is cleared from the list, the Instagram post itself is never affected.

params.name: draftId
params.description: Post id from draft_create or draft_list.

tools.name: draft_get
tools.description: Read one Post Assistant post by id: status, schedule, full caption, assets, music, place, mentions and the last error. Same fields as draft_list, with the caption untruncated.

params.name: draftId
params.description: Post id from draft_create or draft_list.

tools.name: draft_list
tools.description: List Post Assistant posts across all logged-in accounts: drafts, scheduled, recently published/failed. Soonest scheduled first, undated drafts last.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter: draft, scheduled, publishing, published, failed, retrying.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max posts, 1-200, default 50.

tools.name: draft_publish
tools.description: Publish a draft to Instagram now — immediate and cannot be undone here. Waits up to ~45s for the result; a slower upload continues in the background (see draft_list).

params.name: draftId
params.description: Post id from draft_create or draft_list.

tools.name: draft_reorder
tools.description: Reorder scheduled posts by permuting the times they already hold: same slots, reassigned in the order listed. All must be already scheduled; to move to a new time use draft_schedule.

params.name: draftIds
params.description: Scheduled post ids in wanted order, earliest slot first. At least two.

tools.name: draft_schedule
tools.description: Schedule an existing draft for a date/time; publishes automatically then (Chrome must be running and online). Use draft_create first, or draft_list for a draftId.

params.name: draftId
params.description: Post id from draft_create or draft_list.

params.name: at
params.description: Publish time, ISO 8601. No offset = browser local time, e.g. "2026-08-22T18:30". Must be future.

tools.name: draft_update
tools.description: Edit an unpublished post: caption, scheduled time, type, music, place, tags or framing. Pass at least one field; others unchanged. Published or publishing posts cannot be edited.

params.name: draftId
params.description: Post id from draft_create or draft_list.

params.name: caption
params.description: New caption, replaces the old one. Empty string clears it.

params.name: at
params.description: New publish time for an already scheduled post, ISO 8601, must be future. To schedule a draft for the first time use draft_schedule.

params.name: type
params.description: Change how it publishes: post, reel or story.

params.name: musicTrackId
params.description: Track id from music_search to attach. Empty string removes the track.

params.name: musicTrackName
params.description: Track title from music_search, shown as label. Optional, goes with musicTrackId.

params.name: location
params.description: Place name to tag; first Instagram match wins. Empty string removes the place.

params.name: mentions
params.description: Usernames to tag, without @, replacing the current tags. Empty array removes them all.

params.name: stretchToFill
params.description: true fills the frame (crops letterbox), false letterboxes. Omit to leave framing as is.

tools.name: follow_requests_list
tools.description: List pending follow requests to your account.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Resume token from a previous call's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: growth_configure
tools.description: Set lead-engagement config: source accounts, likes per lead, leads scanned per source, skip filters. Partial — only fields you pass change. Editing interrupts a run in progress.

params.name: custom
params.description: Take leads from the given `sources` (true) or from accounts you follow (false).

params.name: sources
params.description: Space-separated @usernames to pull leads from; used when custom=true.

params.name: minLikes
params.description: Min likes per lead (>=1).

params.name: maxLikes
params.description: Max likes per lead (>= minLikes).

params.name: leadsToScan
params.description: Leads to scan per source (>=1).

params.name: bannedWords
params.description: Space-separated words; skip leads whose posts contain them.

params.name: bannedUsernames
params.description: Space-separated @usernames to skip.

params.name: excludedSources
params.description: Space-separated @usernames excluded from source scanning.

tools.name: growth_export
tools.description: Export lead-engagement results (leads and likes made) to a CSV file; returns the path.

tools.name: growth_pause
tools.description: Turn off lead engagement for the logged-in account. No further likes are made until growth_start.

tools.name: growth_start
tools.description: Turn on lead engagement: scan the configured sources and like leads’ posts, paced by the like budget and rate-limit backoff. Runs in the background; poll growth_status.

tools.name: growth_status
tools.description: Lead-engagement state for the logged-in account: on/off, current config, leads and sources found, likes made, and remaining daily like budget.

tools.name: ig_action
tools.description: Like, unlike, follow or unfollow. One target per call.

params.name: type
params.description: Exactly one of: "like", "unlike", "follow", "unfollow". No other value is accepted.

params.name: username
params.description: Target account, without @. Required for like, follow and unfollow; ignored by unlike. For "like" INSSIST picks which recent post of that account to like.

params.name: postId
params.description: Target post for "unlike", as returned by a preceding like. Ignored by the other types.

params.name: shortcode
params.description: Alternative target for "unlike": the post shortcode from a permalink (/p/<shortcode>/).

tools.name: ig_block
tools.description: Block an account, or unblock with `unblock: true`. Blocking cuts all contact and hides your profile from them.

params.name: user
params.description: Account: username, profile URL, or numeric id.

params.name: unblock
params.description: True to unblock; default false.

tools.name: ig_fetch_post
tools.description: Fetch one post by url or shortcode: caption, owner, media type, like/comment counts, timestamp, media urls. Works for /p/, /reel/, /tv/. Like ig_fetch_posts plus owner and full-size media.

params.name: url
params.description: Post permalink, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/p/ABC123/. Give this or shortcode.

params.name: shortcode
params.description: Post shortcode on its own, e.g. ABC123. Give this or url.

tools.name: ig_fetch_posts
tools.description: Fetch most recent posts of an account: caption, media type, likes, comments, timestamp, shortcode, permalink. Newest first. Pages internally; returns nextCursor when more remain.

params.name: username
params.description: Account username.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max posts to return, 1-1500, default 50.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Resume token from a previous call's nextCursor. Omit for newest.

tools.name: ig_fetch_profile
tools.description: Fetch profile of an account: bio, links, follower/following/post counts, flags, viewer relationship.

params.name: username
params.description: Account username.

tools.name: ig_fetch_saved
tools.description: List your saved posts, newest first.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Resume token from a previous call's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: ig_fetch_stories
tools.description: Fetch an account's currently live stories, as the session sees them. Empty when none or not viewable.

params.name: username
params.description: Account username.

tools.name: ig_post_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a published Instagram post. Own posts only. This cannot be undone. To remove an unpublished draft or a scheduled post from the queue, use draft_delete instead.

params.name: post
params.description: Post: media id, shortcode, or URL.

tools.name: ig_post_edit
tools.description: Edit a published Instagram post's caption. Own posts only.

params.name: post
params.description: Post: media id, shortcode, or URL.

params.name: caption
params.description: The new caption. Pass an empty string to clear it.

tools.name: ig_search
tools.description: Search Instagram accounts and hashtags by free text (the app's search box). Turn a half-remembered name into a username for the other ig_* tools. For taggable places, use location_search.

params.name: query
params.description: What to search for. A leading @ or # is ignored.

params.name: type
params.description: "account" or "hashtag". Omit to search both, which costs two requests.

tools.name: insights_collect
tools.description: Start (or refresh) an analytics scan of an account. Runs in the background and shows in INSSIST's Insights dashboard; poll insights_report for progress and results.

params.name: username
params.description: Account to analyze.

params.name: postsLimit
params.description: Max posts to scan, 1-1500. Omit for the default.

params.name: followers
params.description: Also scan followers for audience stats. Slower.

tools.name: insights_report
tools.description: Read an insights_collect scan: progress while scanning, then metrics — engagement, best times, weekday/hour heatmap, post types, top posts, trends, posting frequency, follower growth. If followers were scanned, also audience quality (bot/suspicious/fresh/clean) and mutual overlap.

params.name: username
params.description: Account passed to insights_collect.

tools.name: location_search
tools.description: Search Instagram places by name for their ids, to tag a post. Pass a returned name to draft_create's `location`. Only places with coordinates (the taggable ones) are returned.

params.name: query
params.description: Place name or address to look for, e.g. "blue bottle coffee" or "new york".

tools.name: music_search
tools.description: Search Instagram's music library by title or artist. Returns track ids for draft_create's musicTrackId.

params.name: query
params.description: Track title or artist.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max tracks, 1-50, default 20.

tools.name: note_set
tools.description: Set the logged-in account's Note. ≤60-chars. Atop the DM inbox avatar, gone in 24h. Pushes you to the top of the DM list. Empty text clears it.

params.name: text
params.description: Note text (≤60 chars). Empty or omitted clears the current note.

tools.name: notifications_list
tools.description: Recent notifications: comments, likes, follows, mentions.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter: all (default), comments, likes, follows or mentions.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max notifications to return, 1-200, default 50. Newest first.

tools.name: peers_export
tools.description: Export a full followers/following list to a CSV file; returns the file path. Run peers_scan first for other accounts.

params.name: username
params.description: Account to export, without @. Omit for the logged-in account.

params.name: type
params.description: List: followers (default) or following.

tools.name: peers_report
tools.description: Read a page of a collected followers/following list (from/limit). Own account uses stored data, richer (adds `mutual`, `followedOn`; `mutual` is null when not checked yet); other accounts need peers_scan first. Whole list: peers_export.

params.name: username
params.description: Account whose list to read, without @. Omit for the logged-in account.

params.name: type
params.description: List: followers (default) or following.

params.name: from
params.description: Zero-based offset into the list, default 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size, 1-1000, default 100.

tools.name: peers_scan
tools.description: Start collecting an account's followers or following.

params.name: username
params.description: Account to scan, without @. Omit for the logged-in account.

params.name: type
params.description: Collect followers (default) or following.

tools.name: profile_update
tools.description: Edit the logged-in account's bio (the text under the name on the profile). Own account only; changing bio links is not supported (app-only). Other profile fields are left untouched.

params.name: bio
params.description: The new bio text. Pass an empty string to clear it.

tools.name: story_viewers
tools.description: See who viewed one of your active stories.

params.name: storyId
params.description: Story media id, from ig_fetch_stories. Must be one of your own active stories.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Resume token from a previous call's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: unfollowers_export
tools.description: Export the full list of accounts that unfollowed you to a CSV file; returns the path.

tools.name: unfollowers_report
tools.description: List accounts that unfollowed you in the last 7 days, from stored scan data. Run unfollowers_scan to refresh; poll `scanning` and `lastScanOn` for freshness.

tools.name: unfollowers_scan
tools.description: Start an unfollower scan for the logged-in account. Runs in the background through INSSIST's paced follower crawl; poll unfollowers_report for progress and results.
